Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Quality Engineer to establish and strengthen quality assurance across Atlas Technica’s data and business intelligence solutions. As the first dedicated Data QA Engineer on the team, this individual will play an important role in developing testing standards, quality controls, and repeatable QA processes across ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse solutions, Power BI, and embedded reporting.

The Data Quality Engineer will validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, security, and business logic across the full data lifecycle—from source systems and integration processes through semantic models and client-facing reporting. This role will work closely with Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, and business stakeholders to identify quality risks early and improve release readiness.

The successful candidate will combine strong SQL and data-testing expertise with analytical thinking, attention to detail, clear documentation, and the ability to establish quality practices within an evolving data environment.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Define and implement QA processes, testing standards, quality controls, and release gates for Data and Business Intelligence solutions
  • Design and execute test plans across ETL and ELT pipelines, Data Warehouse solutions, Power BI reports, and embedded reporting applications
  • Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, transformation logic, and business rules across source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, and reporting layers
  • Perform source-to-target validation, data reconciliation, integration testing, regression testing, and end-to-end testing
  • Test Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, dashboards, and reporting functionality
  • Validate complex KPIs, business metrics, calculations, aggregations, and reporting logic against defined business requirements and expected outcomes
  • Validate Row-Level Security, customer data isolation, access controls, and other security-related functionality within embedded analytics solutions
  • Investigate data-quality issues, perform root cause analysis, document defects, and collaborate with technical teams through resolution and validation
  • Participate in requirements reviews, solution-design discussions, and data-model validation to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, defect reports, testing procedures, QA metrics, and supporting quality documentation
  • Partner closely with Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, and business stakeholders to improve data quality and release readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement of QA practices and promote a quality-first approach across data and analytics development

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of overall quality assurance experience across Software QA, Automation QA, Data QA, or other quality-focused roles, including 3+ years of experience in Data QA, ETL testing, Data Warehouse testing, or BI testing
  • Demonstrated experience establishing QA processes, test strategies, testing standards, or quality-control practices
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to develop complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and testing
  • Experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, and integration processes
  • Strong understanding of Data Warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas
  • Experience testing Power BI reports, semantic models, dashboards, DAX calculations, and related reporting functionality
  • Experience testing Power BI Embedded or comparable customer-facing analytics solutions
  • Strong understanding of data accuracy, completeness, consistency, business-rule validation, and source-to-target reconciliation
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Data Engineers, BI Developers, technical stakeholders, and business partners
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Desirable Qualities:

  • Experience validating historical data models and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps
  • Familiarity with data monitoring, data freshness validation, and ongoing data-quality controls
  • Knowledge of Power BI REST APIs, report lineage, metadata validation, or related Power BI administration capabilities
  • Experience with performance, scalability, access-control, or security testing of analytics solutions
  • Experience working within Agile development environments such as Scrum or Kanban
  • Microsoft Azure, Power BI, Data Engineering, Quality Assurance, or related technical certifications
